questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which is correct example of condensation polymer?
questions.solution: Nylon 6, 6 and dacron are the examples of condensation polymers. Condensation polymers are formed by condensation of two or more bifunctional monomers with the elimination of simple molecules like $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}, \mathrm{NH}_3$, alcohol, etc. Dacron is formed from ethylene glycol and terephthalic acid with the removal of $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}$. Nylon 6, 6 is formed from hexamethylenediamine and adipic acid with the removal of $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}$.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Chain transfer reagent is
questions.solution: A substance that is able to cause a chain transfer in a chain polymerisation is called a chain transfer agent. It gives an atom to the radical at the growing end of a polymer chain and in doing so it results into a radical which can start the growth of a new chain. \(\mathrm{CCl}_4\) is a chain transfer reagent.
